source_or_rationale: Assumed.

item: Ticket price growth per year
source_or_rationale: Below the 4.6% U.S. increase in 2025 (section A), held at a long-run rate. Applies to standard and premium prices.

item: Food and beverage per patron growth per year
source_or_rationale: Close to the 3.3% U.S. increase in 2025 (section A).

item: Operating cost inflation per year
source_or_rationale: Assumed.

item: Attendance trend per year
source_or_rationale: U.S. attendance fell 0.7% in 2025 (section A); held flat.

item: Cash tax rate on incremental profit
source_or_rationale: AMC's federal NOLs (section A) cover the profit for all 10 years, so there is no cash tax. Raise this to test an owner that pays tax. Years with a tax loss are assumed to offset other taxable income.

item: Depreciation life of the conversion
source_or_rationale: Matches the JRSA term (section A).

item: Residual value at the end of year 10, % of conversion cost
source_or_rationale: Equipment returns to IMAX at the end of a JRSA (IMAX 10-K, p. 42). Assumed zero.

item: Discount rate
source_or_rationale: AMC's own rate for U.S. theatre cash flows (section A).

item: Attendance uplift on the converted screen
source_or_rationale: Assumed. IMAX screens take about five times the box office of an average screen (section B); the Model sheet shows the converted screen's multiple for comparison.

item: Premium surcharge per ticket, year 1
source_or_rationale: Assumed. AMC does not publish prices by format.

item: Share of the extra attendance moved from other screens in the same theatre
source_or_rationale: Assumed. Some premium patrons would have seen the same film on a standard screen.

item: Format partner's share of the converted screen's box office
source_or_rationale: Base: hybrid-style deal; IMAX says the hybrid box-office percentage is typically half the traditional rate (IMAX 10-K, p. 42). Downside: IMAX's blended 2025 JRSA rate (section B). Upside: assumed.

source_or_rationale: Assumed range for savings or overruns on the whole conversion cost (equipment and construction).

source_or_rationale: Conversion cost estimate (section C) times the scenario multiplier above.
